{{Top|leg}}
A '''worldgouger''' was a type of [[Starship/Legends|starship]] utilized by the [[Corporate Sector Authority/Legends|Corporate Sector Authority]] to exploit resources to fuel the [[Corporate Sector/Legends|Corporate Sector's]] [[Factory/Legends|factories]] and processing plants.
